source_title: Big blow for India: Star pacer ruled out of New Zealand ODI series due to injury - The Times of India
source_excerpt: India's preparations for the upcoming ODI series against New Zealand have suffered a setback, with pacer Prasidh Krishna ruled out of the five-match series, the BCCI confirmed on Friday.The right-arm pacer has not played competitive cricket since picking up an injury midway through the second ODI against the West Indies. According to the BCCI, he needs more time to build up his bowling workload before he can return to match action."Prasidh Krishna, whose availability for India's five-match ODI series against New Zealand was subject to fitness clearance, is ruled out of the ODI series. The right-arm pacer, who is recovering from the hamstring injury, will need additional time to build up the workload required to be ready for matches," the BCCI said in a media release.Prasidh will join the India A squad for the third and final four-day match against New Zealand A, subject to clearing the Return to Play (RTP) assessment. The match will give him an opportunity to get some game time ahead of the Test series.Meanwhile, Mohammed Siraj will join India A for the second four-day match against New Zealand A, which begins on October 31, 2026.Nitish Kumar Reddy will remain with India's ODI squad for the first match against New Zealand, scheduled for November 4, 2026. He will then join India A for the third and final four-day match against New Zealand A to get match practice ahead of the two-Test series, which begins on November 19, 2026.India A's updated squad for the second four-day match against New Zealand A: Yashasvi Jaiswal, Sai Sudharsan, Devdutt Padikkal, Yash Rathod, R.
